# Unisys

> Unisys is a global technology solutions company for cloud, AI, digital workplace, applications and enterprise computing. This file indexes key pages across Unisys.com — solutions, industries, client stories, insights, research and artificial intelligence content — for use by LLMs and AI agents. Descriptions below are drawn from each page's meta description.

## Solutions

- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/artificial-intelligence/): AI can't drive innovation without the right foundation. Is your data ready? Our practical guide shows you how to prepare your data for success, regardless of your starting point.
- [Cloud Applications and Infrastructure](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/cai/): Turn technology investments into competitive advantages that drive measurable growth. Insights from 1,000 decision-makers show how smart cloud strategies outperform costly experiments.
- [Cloud Solutions for Modern Applications](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/cai/applications/): With the Unisys Application Transformation solution, you can move your business applications to the cloud and transform them to meet your changing needs.
- [Cloud Management Solutions](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/cai/cloud-management/): New research: Discover the four strategies 1,000 leaders use to turn AI and cloud into results boards can measure.
- [Cybersecurity Solutions](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/cai/cybersecurity/): Unisys Attack Surface Discovery helps organizations interested in continuous cybersecurity visibility, monitoring and response.
- [Data and Analytics Solutions](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/cai/data-analytics/): With Unisys Data Governance and Management solutions, we'll assess your environment and share strategies for how to best capture, store and share data.
- [Data Center Services](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/data-center-services/): Explore advanced data center services including AIOps and data center liquid cooling designed to support AI workloads with improved performance, efficiency, and resilience.
- [Digital Workplace Solutions](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/dws/): Our latest research shows how employee experience can double your revenue odds.
- [Agentic Service Desk](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/dws/field-services-and-support/agentic-service-desk/): Stop waiting for support tickets to pile up. AI-powered automation fixes issues before employees notice, breaks down language barriers, and lets people get help their way. See how IDC research validates this approach.
- [Enterprise Computing](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/ecs/): Modernize around the core and integrate with cloud services, AI applications and digital channels.
- [IT Consulting Services](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/consulting/): Unisys offers digital transformation management consulting to envision and create your ideal digital workplace, connect strategy to impact with cloud consulting and protect your digital world with cybersecurity consulting.
- [ClearPath Forward Transaction Processing Solutions](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/clearpath-forward/): Unisys enterprise computing solutions introduces Clearpath forward transaction processing, designed to support high-volume transaction processing for today's organizations.
- [Unisys Logistics Optimization](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/unisys-logistics-optimization/): Save time. Boost revenue. Discover how patent-pending AI models can revolutionize space utilization, route planning and inventory management.
- [Next Generation Computing Solutions](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/next-gen-compute/): Enhance your enterprise computing with Unisys next-generation enterprise computing solutions. Learn secure, reliable ways to solve complicated calculations.
- [Business Process Outsourcing](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/business-process-outsourcing/): Costs are increasing, regulations and compliance is intensifying, and borrowers expect more.

## Industries

- [Industry-Specific IT Solutions Overview](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/industries/): Discover tailored technology solutions for financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, education, public sector and more. Optimize operations and drive digital transformation with Unisys.
- [Energy & Utilities](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/industries/energy-utilities/): Unisys partners with energy and utilities leaders to turn bold technology goals into everyday performance.
- [Financial Services](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/industries/financial-services/): Navigate evolving customer expectations, regulatory pressures and cyber threats.
- [Healthcare & Life Sciences](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/industries/healthcare-and-life-sciences/): Unisys provides secure IT solutions designed for healthcare and life sciences organizations. Modernize operations, protect patient data and accelerate medical innovation while reducing costs.
- [Higher Education](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/industries/higher-education/): Clear the high bar set for higher education by transforming learning experiences, strengthening data security and optimizing your device and support strategy for faculty and staff.
- [Manufacturing](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/industries/manufacturing/): Elevate manufacturing and construction operations with Unisys digital solutions. From AI-driven analytics to device management, we help optimize production, enhance security and drive measurable business outcomes.
- [Public Sector](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/industries/public-sector/): Constituents want convenient, fast access to support from government agencies.
- [Retail, Hospitality and Consumer Goods](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/industries/retail-and-consumer-goods/): Expand your IT infrastructure to deliver consistent, frictionless experiences across all channels — meeting customers wherever and whenever they shop.

## Client Stories

- [Our Clients Overview](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/): Explore videos and stories where Unisys has helped businesses and governments improve the lives of their customers and citizens.
- [Carnival Cruise Line](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/carnival/): Founded in 1972, Carnival is the world's most popular cruise line — operating 29 ships across 19 countries with roughly 1,800 voyages a year.
- [Cushman & Wakefield](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/cushmanwakefield/): Global commercial real estate services leader with more than 52,000 employees in nearly 400 offices operating in nearly 60 countries.
- [Omnicom's Global Technology Transformation](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/omnicom/): How Unisys helped connect 70,000 marketing professionals through cloud and workplace modernization.
- [Heineken's Unified Approach to Global IT Operations](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/heineken/): Brewing strong support experiences for employees.
- [Benjamin Moore](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/benjamin-moore/): Painting a secure future in the cloud with Unisys and oXya.
- [NI: Modernizing Apps with AI Power](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/ni-modernizing-apps-with-ai-power/): Modernizing an innovation leader with a powerful generative AI assistant.
- [California State University](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/california-state-university/): Enhance the student learning experience and deliver technology services critical to student success and Graduation Initiatives 2025.
- [Austrian Ministry of Finance: Advancing Public Service Efficiency](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/advancing-public-service-efficiency-at-the-austrian-ministry-of-finance/): A leap forward with AI-driven automation.
- [Queensland Transport and Main Roads: Driving Identity Security Forward](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/queensland-government-department-of-transport-and-main-roads-qtmr/): Move and connect people, places, goods and services safely, efficiently and effectively across Queensland, Australia.

## Insights

- [Unisys Blog, Podcasts and Announcements](https://www.unisys.com/blog/): View the latest industry tips about digital workplace solutions, the hybrid workplace, enterprise cloud solutions and more with Unisys blogs and podcasts.
- [Digital Workplace Deep Dive Podcast](https://www.unisys.com/dws-deep-dive/): In this podcast series we interview industry experts, examine how AI, IoT, automation, analytics, cloud, mobile & other technologies affects digital workplace.
- [Videos and Webinars](https://www.unisys.com/videos-and-webinars/): Unisys videos and on-demand webinars keep you updated with the latest information about our solutions and services.
- [How Agentic AI Is Advancing Application Quality Assurance](https://www.unisys.com/blog-post/cis/how-agentic-ai-is-advancing-application-quality-assurance/): AI is streamlining code development and can transform quality assurance too. Read our latest blog post to learn why and how to use AI for application QA.
- [What Separates a True Agentic Service Desk from a Rebranded Chatbot](https://www.unisys.com/blog-post/dws/what-separates-a-true-agentic-service-desk-from-a-rebranded-chatbot/): Agentic AI won't fix your service desk if you treat it like a chatbot upgrade. See why the real gain comes from redesigning the work around it.
- [Keep the Trusted Core, Modernize Around It with AI](https://www.unisys.com/blog-post/ecs/keep-the-trusted-core-modernize-around-it-with-ai/): Modernization doesn't mean abandoning the systems you trust. See how enterprises can apply AI around the core while keeping it secure and reliable.

## Research

- [Unisys Research: Navigate Emerging Horizons in Technology](https://www.unisys.com/research/): Explore our research repository to elevate your operational strategy with unparalleled insights.
- [Unisys AI & Cloud Insights Report 2026](https://www.unisys.com/report/unisys-ai-cloud-insights-report-2026/): Get insights from 1,000 senior IT and business leaders across eight markets, and see what separates real results from expensive experiments.
- [Research Insights: Frontline in Focus](https://www.unisys.com/report/dws/research-insights-frontline-in-focus/): Amplify frontline output, increase workforce satisfaction and improve the customer experience with tech strategies outlined in this research report from Unisys and ISG.
- [Are You Maximizing the Power of Generative AI?](https://www.unisys.com/report/ai/are-you-maximizing-the-power-of-generative-ai/): What are business leaders' perspectives on gen AI adoption, challenges, and best practices for better outcomes? Download this Unisys-sponsored HBR report.

## Artificial Intelligence

- [Artificial Intelligence Solutions](https://www.unisys.com/solutions/artificial-intelligence/): AI can't drive innovation without the right foundation. Is your data ready? Our practical guide shows you how to prepare your data for success, regardless of your starting point.
- [Your AI Journey. Our Expert Navigation.](https://www.unisys.com/cp/ai-driven-transformation/): Turn AI someday into AI today. With Unisys, you can turn ambitious ideas into tangible results, driving your business forward responsibly.
- [Responsible AI Statement](https://www.unisys.com/about-unisys/ai-mission-statement/): At Unisys, we believe that AI, when used responsibly, can enhance how we serve our clients, operate our business, and empower our associates.
- [Are You Maximizing the Power of Generative AI?](https://www.unisys.com/report/ai/are-you-maximizing-the-power-of-generative-ai/): What are business leaders' perspectives on gen AI adoption, challenges, and best practices for better outcomes? Download this Unisys-sponsored HBR report.
- [Unisys AI & Cloud Insights Report 2026](https://www.unisys.com/report/unisys-ai-cloud-insights-report-2026/): Get insights from 1,000 senior IT and business leaders across eight markets, and see what separates real results from expensive experiments.
- [How Agentic AI Is Advancing Application Quality Assurance](https://www.unisys.com/blog-post/cis/how-agentic-ai-is-advancing-application-quality-assurance/): AI is streamlining code development and can transform quality assurance too. Read our latest blog post to learn why and how to use AI for application QA.
- [What Separates a True Agentic Service Desk from a Rebranded Chatbot](https://www.unisys.com/blog-post/dws/what-separates-a-true-agentic-service-desk-from-a-rebranded-chatbot/): Agentic AI won't fix your service desk if you treat it like a chatbot upgrade. See why the real gain comes from redesigning the work around it.
- [NI: Modernizing Apps with AI Power](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/ni-modernizing-apps-with-ai-power/): Modernizing an innovation leader with a powerful generative AI assistant.
- [Austrian Ministry of Finance: Advancing Public Service Efficiency](https://www.unisys.com/our-clients/advancing-public-service-efficiency-at-the-austrian-ministry-of-finance/): A leap forward with AI-driven automation.

    Solutions that power progress

    From AI and cloud to cybersecurity, digital workplace and enterprise computing solutions, we deliver the technology foundation and industry expertise your organization needs to excel.

    AI that drives human innovation

    Turn AI investments into business results. Unisys combines strategic AI advisory, solution development, and scalable infrastructure with the change management expertise you need to succeed. We help you put AI to work where it matters most, positioning you to compete and grow with confidence.

    Learn more

    Cloud management that simplifies your cloud journey

    Get more from your cloud investments. Unisys cloud solutions simplify migration, modernization and cloud management across cloud hosts like AWS, Azure, Google, and your data center. Intelligent automation simplifies complexity while keeping costs predictable and performance strong.

    Learn more

    Modern applications that deliver business value, wherever your organization runs

    Thrive in a digital-first world by modernizing existing applications, embedding AI-driven intelligence and automation, and securely developing new ones that prioritize user experience. Unisys helps you modernize legacy apps, migrate to the cloud, and build cloud-native solutions that are scalable, intuitive, and cost-effective. Run your business with applications tailored to you. 

    Learn more

    Cybersecurity solutions that protect your most valuable assets

    Your organization is only as secure as its weakest link. As technology evolves, so do cybersecurity threats. Unisys helps you build Zero Trust protection and operational resilience across your enterprise. We work with you to secure data, address threats, fortify customer trust and comply with regulations.

    Learn more

    Workplace solutions that drive business outcomes and innovation

    Empower and support your teams for maximum productivity anywhere. Unisys delivers agentic AI-driven service desk support, industry-leading field services, and flexible device subscription options that scale with you. Remove IT barriers while creating experiences people love, giving teams the freedom to focus on innovation.  

    Learn more

    Enterprise Computing

    Power mission-critical operations with high-performance, scalable computing built for the future. We deliver secure infrastructure, optimized workloads, and continuous reliability across complex enterprise environments.

    Learn more
